root_keys.name: trucks
root_keys.note: non-empty; each element is one dispatched vehicle

item_fields.name: truck_id
item_fields.note: non-empty string; must be unique across the trucks list

item_fields.name: cab_model
item_fields.note: must match a vehicle-type name in data/日常发运车型.xlsx; changing this changes which vehicle was chosen

item_fields.name: blocks
item_fields.note: 3-D placement blocks inside this truck; each block is one cargo unit

item_fields.name: sku
item_fields.note: SKU/物料代码; names what is placed, not the placement decision itself

item_fields.name: qty
item_fields.note: number of boxes in this block; must be > 0

item_fields.name: weight_kg
item_fields.note: gross weight of this block in kg

item_fields.name: dx
item_fields.note: block extent along x; must be > 0

item_fields.name: dy
item_fields.note: block extent along y; must be > 0

item_fields.name: dz
item_fields.note: block extent along z; must be > 0

item_fields.name: seq_load
item_fields.note: loading sequence within this truck; values must form a permutation of 1..N where N = len(blocks)

item_fields.name: seq_unload
item_fields.note: unloading sequence; checked only if present; single-stop rule: expected = N+1 - seq_load

root_keys.name: unassigned
root_keys.note: SKUs that could not be loaded onto any truck; defaults to [] if key is absent or null

structural_checks: solution.json top level must be a JSON object (dict), not a list or any other type
trucks must be a non-empty list (missing key or empty list both cause fatal error)
each truck.truck_id must be a non-empty string
truck_id values must be unique across the entire trucks list
each truck.cab_model must match a vehicle-type name present in data/日常发运车型.xlsx
each block must contain all nine required fields: sku, qty, weight_kg, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, seq_load
block.dx, block.dy, block.dz must each be strictly > 0
seq_load values within one truck must be a permutation of 1..N (N = number of blocks in that truck)
alias_notes: trucks has NO aliases — the key must be exactly 'trucks'
unassigned has NO aliases — the key must be exactly 'unassigned' (or the key may be absent)
no .get() or-chains were found on any submission key; every field name is a single fixed string
